units: per 100 g edible portion; kcal = nutrient 1008 (208) rounded to whole kcal; protein_g 1003 (203); fat_g 1004 (204); carb_g 1005 (205, by difference); fiber_g 1079 (291); 0.1 g half-up

overlap.also_excluded: the real SR ids of every shipped description (so a re-key of the shipped set will not create a duplicate)

fiber_g_null_note: SR Legacy reports no fiber value for these rows; left null rather than invented
selection: Hand-written list of ~900 common household foods and everyday ingredients (staples, pantry, condiments, cuts, dairy, breads), matched to SR Legacy descriptions, minus exotic/brand/obscure rows, then capped per group with whole foods weighted heaviest (vegetables 50, fruits 32, legumes 24, dairy 26, spices+condiments 24, grains 22, poultry/eggs 18, fish 18, ...).

sources.took: food.csv (fdc_id, description), food_nutrient.csv (amounts for nutrients 1008/1003/1004/1005/1079), nutrient.csv, food_category.csv; data_type SR Legacy (USDA, CC0). Values read straight from the raw CSV and cross-checked against a second parse.
